hero.mainText: Start your language journey with interactive exercises and real-life practice. Build your skills step by step in a supportive, engaging environment designed for learners of all levels.
hero.subText: Master a new language, one step at a time
hero.mobileText: Practice different exercises with AI. It's better than any other websites. Just give it a try and you'll see!

aiSection.title: Learn a language with AI
aiSection.description: Practice through personalized exercises generated by artificial intelligence.

languageSelect.desiredLanguageChooseTitle: What language do you want to learn?

levelChoose.a1Desc: Can understand and use very basic phrases and introductions; can ask and answer simple questions.
levelChoose.a2Desc: Handles everyday tasks and routine exchanges; can describe in simple terms family, shopping, local geography.
levelChoose.b1Desc: Communicates on familiar topics, produces simple connected text; can narrate experiences and ambitions.
levelChoose.b2Desc: Understands main ideas of complex text; interacts with fluency and spontaneity in most situations.
levelChoose.c1Desc: Uses language flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes; expresses ideas coherently and precisely.
levelChoose.c2Desc: Near-native mastery; understands virtually everything heard or read, and expresses nuances effortlessly.

essay.title: Write an essay
essay.desc: Write a short essay on the given topic to practice your writing skills.

essay.title: Essay Writing
essay.subtitle: Write an essay expressing your thoughts and arguments.
essay.mainInstruction: Express your thoughts and arguments in a well-structured essay.
essay.hint: Organize your ideas clearly and support them with examples.
essay.textareaPlaceholder: Write your essay here. Start with an introduction, develop your main ideas in separate paragraphs, and finish with a conclusion. Use linking words and pay attention to structure, clarity, and grammar.
essay.aiVersion: How would AI write essay on this topic:

imageDesc.title: Describe the Image
imageDesc.subtitle: Look at the picture and write a detailed description of what you see.
imageDesc.mainInstruction: Focus on the setting, actions, and details.
imageDesc.hint: Details bring your description to life.
imageDesc.textareaPlaceholder: Describe what you see in the picture. Who is in the image? What are they doing? What is the setting, mood, and any interesting details?
imageDesc.aiVersion: How would AI describe this image:

collapsible.trigger: How to describe the image: step-by-step plan
collapsible.generalImpressionHint: What is the overall scene? (indoor/outdoor, type of place)
collapsible.peopleObjectsHint: Who or what is in the picture? (number of people, main objects)
collapsible.actionsHint: What are the people doing? (describe activities or interactions)
collapsible.appearanceDetailsHint:
What do the people look like? (clothes, age, mood, posture)
What details stand out? (colors, weather, time of day, background elements)
collapsible.atmosphereHint: What is the mood or feeling of the image? (happy, busy, calm, etc.)
collapsible.personalOpinionHint: What do you think about the image? (interesting, surprising, etc.)

blanks.title: Fill the blanks
blanks.subtitle: Complete the sentence by selecting the correct words
blanks.mainInstruction: Focus on context and choose the best word for each blank.
blanks.hint: Read the whole sentence before filling in the gaps.
